name: StakingDYNA top-up deposits earn interest from the first stake
summary: StakingDYNA's deposit() adds to an existing stake's principal without settling interest or resetting lastProcessAt, so a top-up earns interest for the whole time since the first deposit. The attacker seeded 200 helper stakes, waited a week, then flash-swapped the DYNA/WBNB pair's DYNA through deposit-and-redeem in each helper, compounding a week of 32% APR 200 times out of the reward pool, and sold the DYNA for WBNB.
notes: Anchored on the drain, not on 0x06bbe093 and the other setup txs of blocks 25686617-25687105, which only created the helpers and made their first deposits; 0x96959333 is a failed attempt.

The DYNA paid out of StakingDYNA's reward pool is valued at what the attacker realised (rule 12): its sale of 194.97M DYNA drew 73.846655 WBNB from the DYNA/WBNB pair, while the pair's 78.42 WBNB net outflow also includes the token contract's own fee swap.
